articles.author: Wakeup Flower
articles.description:
1 — Object Lock Modes


Amazon S3 Object Lock supports two modes:



Mode
Purpose




Governance Mode
Protects objects from being deleted or overwritten by most users. Users with special permissions (s3:BypassGovernanceRetention) can still modify or delete objects. Useful when you want flexibility but still enforce retention rules.


Compliance Mode
Provides stricter protection. No one, including the root account, can overwrite or delete an object until the retention period expires. This mode is for strict compliance requirements (e.g., SEC Rule 17a-4(f), FINRA).



✅ So Compliance Mode is the strictest mode.
2 — Retention Mode vs. Legal Hold


These are two separate mechanisms within Object Lock:
Retention Mode



Applies a time-based retention period to an object.
Prevents deletion or mo…
